title: Check-In Collection Figures for the Patient Financial Account
content:
Front-desk collection at the time of service on a Patient Financial Account turns on four per-class settings: whether the fixed copay printed on the insurance card is collected at check-in; the share of the estimated deductible or coinsurance (or self-pay estimate) for the visit collected at the time of service; the most that is collected at the time of service toward such an estimate for one encounter; and whether a copay may be waived case by case on an approved, documented financial hardship.

| Financial class (tier) | Copay collected at check-in | Share of estimate collected (%) | Time-of-service estimate cap per encounter (USD) | Hardship copay waiver permitted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | no |
| Self-Pay Account | no | 100.00 | 400.00 | no |
| Medicare Part B Account | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes |
| Medicare Advantage Account | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes |
| Commercial HMO/EPO Account | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes |
| Commercial PPO/POS Account | yes | 50.00 | 250.00 | yes |
| High-Deductible Health Plan Account | no | 50.00 | 500.00 | no |

**Reading the card.**

- A class showing "no" for the copay and 0.00 for the estimate share collects nothing at check-in; on this card that is the Medicaid Managed Care Account alone.
- The Self-Pay Account collects its whole estimate share, 100.00 percent, up to 400.00 per encounter; the Commercial PPO/POS Account collects 50.00 percent up to 250.00; the High-Deductible Health Plan Account collects 50.00 percent up to 500.00.
- The hardship copay waiver setting is "yes" on the Medicare Part B, Medicare Advantage, Commercial HMO/EPO and Commercial PPO/POS accounts and "no" on the other three classes.
